Denmark Considers Nationwide Ban on Islamic Call to Prayer

Denmark is reportedly considering a nationwide ban on the Islamic call to prayer, known as the Azan. This proposal has been revived amidst concerns expressed by some officials about the "Islamisation" of public spaces. The country's Immigration Minister reportedly stated that parts of Denmark are starting to resemble suburbs of Islamabad. This move reflects ongoing debates within Denmark regarding cultural integration and religious practices.
